summary: A Yes vote authorizes up to $359 million in general obligation bonds for school-facility repairs, replacements, upgrades, and related projects.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes up to $359 million in bonds for school facility improvements while maintaining existing tax rates.
tax.quote: Measure M would authorize up to $359 million in general obligation bonds to fund eligible school facility projects identified in the Facilities Master Plan and project list included in the measure language.

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes funding for repairs, modernization, and improvements at Murrieta Valley Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: Repair or replace deteriorating roofs, plumbing, gas lines, sewer lines, ventilation and electrical systems, where needed

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the proposed bonds for school facility improvements.
